# GX-TXT reusable script catalog

## GX-TXT 0.9.8.10-dev Task 007 full regression

All scripts in this Task 007 section are **version-pinned to GX-TXT 0.9.8.10-dev-007** and the accepted Task 007 evidence layout. Test and oracle runners are safe to reuse only with the documented disposable outputs and read-only inputs; source preparation, manifest refresh, retention, packaging and finalization scripts are one-time release operations and must not be rerun against an already numbered target. Protected locations for this section are the published `GXTXT/DEMO/SESSION` references, earlier Task 005/006 artifacts, original input Sessions, and any existing output path. The per-script rows give the required environment, arguments and actual write scope.

| Script | Purpose and use | Version scope / side effects |
|---|---|---|
| `_work_numeric_v09809/validation/gxtxt-0.9.8.10-dev-007-full-regression-generator-viewer-audit/test_native3d_fallback_gui.tcl` | `env -u LIBGL_ALWAYS_INDIRECT xvfb-run -a tclsh test_native3d_fallback_gui.tcl <framework> <read-only-surface3d-Session> <new-output-dir> [mode]`. Default mode injects one deterministic GLX startup failure and verifies one llvmpipe retry plus unrelated-error/post-interactive-crash refusal. Modes `normal-probe`, `force-software`, `real-x11`, and `hardware-required` run the actual renderer without injection, record its OpenGL vendor/renderer/version and screenshot, and enforce the selected mode where applicable. New output/XDG/private Session only; framework and published releases read-only. `validation/dev058/gui_driver.py` provides X11 pointer/keyboard controls, read-only Tk widget introspection and screenshot capture for human inspection; no controller callbacks or synthetic widget invocation. Runs on a specified isolated DISPLAY against normally launched GX-TXT, writes screenshots/logs only to a private evidence root.

`validation/dev058/gui_host.tcl FRAMEWORK PRIVATE_EVIDENCE LOCAL_PORT`: launches the normal application main entry point with isolated XDG state, adding a localhost read-only observation channel because the actual HC-Consult X server prohibits Tk send. Viewer opening and all product actions still use visible X11 controls. Rejects controller calls/widget mutation; observer provides widget positions and supplementary diagnostic state only. Writes private XDG/process evidence only; neither framework nor canonical Sessions are changed. `gui_driver.py` uses `GX_GUI_OBSERVER_PORT` when provided and `GX_GUI_SHOT_WIDGET` for window-only captures on the user's display, avoiding unrelated desktop content.

`validation/dev058/open_journey.py PRIVATE_SESSION PRIVATE_EVIDENCE`: opens the existing disposable Session through Open Session, its actual directory dialog, the Viewers tab/list and Open viewer button; captures the idle Workbench screenshot for inspection. Uses the driver and `GX_GUI_OBSERVER_PORT`/DISPLAY; no product callbacks. Writes a screenshot and normal product-managed state only in the private Session/XDG roots.

`validation/dev058/build_native.sh FRAMEWORK PRIVATE_BUILD`: builds current Native2D and runs packaged CTest, then copies the successful adapter to its three existing candidate CORE/Workbench/Curve Fit destinations. Guarded to `_work_gxtxt_dev058`; no release/installation/Session writes. `native_presentation058.c`: independent tangent-angle measurement invariance under presentation-only interpolation, preserving explicit point-frame interpolation API. Compile against current candidate C99/math, optionally ASAN/UBSAN; memory/separate executable/log only.

`validation/dev058/chrome_probe.tcl FRAMEWORK PRIVATE_OUTPUT`: isolated HC-Consult/Xvfb paint diagnosis comparing placed ttk/classic frame ancestry around identical shared viewport glyph buttons and a canvas line. No Workbench or acceptance claims. Opens one private diagnostic window, reads framework glyph authority, creates no Sessions or published changes. Capture and inspect root pixels; close only that private window afterward.

`validation/dev058/capture_window.ps1 -Title UNIQUE_PRIVATE_TITLE -Output PRIVATE_PNG`: real Windows desktop pixel capture of one uniquely named private X11 validation window on pc-giux. Necessary to compare VcXsrv multiwindow displayed pixels against XGetImage artifacts. Uses native enumeration/title match, foregrounds only that private window and captures its rectangle; refuses missing/ambiguous title. Writes only the chosen evidence PNG. Never captures the full desktop or changes application/Session/release data.

Dev-058 actual-display captures must use `capture_window.ps1` against the validation host's unique window titles and verify native foreground ownership before saving. VcXsrv multiwindow XGetImage/root captures omit/reorder child-window pixels and may capture occluded backing stores; they are diagnostic only, never acceptance. The helper briefly pairs foreground input threads to activate only the matched private window, detaches in `finally`, verifies ownership and captures its rectangle; missing/occluded/ambiguous windows fail without a screenshot. The host's title-only diagnostic tagging creates no product action. PowerShell's normal inline invocation runs the exact reviewed script body without changing execution-policy settings.

The058 desktop capture helper additionally accepts `-Action click -X SCREEN_X -Y SCREEN_Y`, `-Action type -Text LITERAL`, or `-Action key -Text SENDKEYS`, optionally omitting Output. It verifies/activates the uniquely named private native window, restricts clicks to its client rectangle, and routes real Windows pointer/keyboard input through VcXsrv into X11. This is the manual input path, not a Tk callback or API bypass. Combined input/capture refuses a changed foreground. New private Session GUI state is the only product side effect; burst modes remain separate and unpaced. Client-only screenshots exclude native frame shadows and unrelated desktop margins.

`validation/dev058/desktop_worker.ps1 -Root PRIVATE_REQUEST_DIRECTORY -Handler capture_window.ps1`: persistent private pc-giux GUI worker executes structured JSON requests through the reviewed native input/capture handler, caches only compiled Win32 helpers, writes timestamped OK/FAIL receipts, and stops when its private stop file is created. SMB request/response files and optional screenshots are the only file writes. No Tk callbacks/geometry APIs are used; same private unique-title/foreground/client-rectangle guards apply. `desktop_driver.py` supplies Linux-side widget-location reads and queued real-user actions, refusing failed/missing receipts and logging exact arguments/results. No published/framework/canonical Session writes.

`validation/dev058/chrome_host_probe.tcl FRAMEWORK`: exact shared ViewportHost create/controls/layout versus a plain grid-managed glyph strip, in one uniquely named private X11 diagnostic window. A memory-only Native scene owns no user data. Read-only framework, no Session/publication writes; capture/inspect its native desktop client pixels. This is diagnosis, not Workbench workflow acceptance.

The058 shared-host ownership experiment resolves chrome ancestry from the canvas's geometry manager (`pack/grid/place -in`) and supplies host-only panel-widget lookup, avoiding Workbench path assumptions. The failed extra-frame-removal experiment was reverted. Exact shared-host/grid probes render correctly, isolating the missing idle children to Workbench's sibling-overlay integration. These are hypotheses until a fresh foreground Workbench screenshot validates the correction; no PASS or publication follows from widget metadata.

Dev058 native input extensions (`desktop_driver.py`/`capture_window.ps1`): `at/move/right WIDGET X Y [add|subtract]`, `drag WIDGET X Y X2 Y2 COUNT`, `wheel WIDGET X Y COUNT DELTA`. Coordinates are relative to observed visible widgets; real Win32 input traverses VcXsrv/X11. Modifier keys are released in finally. Drag/wheel bursts submit without per-event waits and report submission duration; SMB scheduling time is not application latency. Worker03 uses the updated handler and completes active-file removal before publishing each receipt. Changes remain limited to private GUI Sessions and evidence. These action receipts do not constitute visually reviewed acceptance.

`desktop_driver.py menu MENUBUTTON LABEL` reads only menu labels/enabled states, opens the visible menubutton with a real click and chooses the requested entry with real Home/Down/Enter keyboard input. No menu invoke or callback execution. The subsequent native screenshot remains the mandatory acceptance evidence.

`desktop_driver.py native_key UNIQUE_PRIVATE_TITLE SENDKEYS` provides the same uniquely scoped real keyboard input for diagnostic windows without a widget observer. It is also used to dismiss a desktop overlay accidentally triggered by a validation shortcut; no application API or third-party data is accessed.

Correction: Tk/X11 Menu does not bind Home to the first entry. The earlier keyboard-count traversal selected the wrong entry; its screenshots are diagnostic FAILs. `desktop_driver.py menu` now opens the menubutton and clicks the visible requested menu row using observed menu-root coordinates and its authoritative `yposition` bounds. It reads menu metadata only, with no invoke/API shortcut. Subsequent screenshot verifies the intended GUI result.

VcXsrv title compatibility: actual native enumeration shows arrow-bearing Tk titles represented with `?` in WM_NAME. The desktop driver applies that Latin-1 replacement only when matching native captions; the helper still refuses ambiguous/missing matches. Tk-rendered body text remains untouched. No product code or native window attributes are changed.

The legacy interaction_v1 preview experiment was removed after auditing override composition: dev057's construction authority in interaction_v2 owns the active placement path. The canvas ancestry correction is the only current GUI geometry/chrome fix; drawing lifecycle changes require a reproduced visible failure in the active path before modification. Candidate GUI04/journey01 loaded the prior inactive v1 change, so final acceptance must bind a fresh process to the final source.

Active construction lifecycle correction is now in interaction_v2: `construction_preview` evaluates tentative placements, then falls back to the valid placed prefix if the tentative endpoint is degenerate. A candidate that references the most recently placed control uses the prefix directly. Each click refreshes its own placed preview, so missing/coalesced motion does not erase established geometry. This reuses public Native construction and creates no duplicate topology/evaluator. Baseline real desktop 05/06/07 shows vertices without a segment after click two, followed by visible retained Line after Finish. Fresh candidate pointer screenshots are still required before acceptance.

`gui_host.tcl` additionally records diagnostic-only B1-Motion/wheel/release counters and last delivery time via the normal `all` bindtag, and prints GUI058_READY after normal main initialization. It does not render, persist, select or invoke controllers. These counters supplement native burst timing/visible screenshots; neither event counts nor READY substitute for visual acceptance.

Worker04 native drag uses an80ms gesture-start button dwell before unpaced motion, and Alt (X11 Mod1) for subtract as specified by the existing semantic selection UI; Shift/Ctrl remain add. It records real X11 delivery through read-only host counters via TCP (`Port`, private Linux host), measuring receipt of the final release/all wheel events directly after submission, without SMB scheduling delays. A two-second delivery failure throws, never PASS. Optional `drag ... COUNT FRAME_PREFIX` captures three actual client frames during motion without per-event settling; all frames require visual inspection. Counters must exist in a fresh host. This is diagnostic input/timing only; no product controller or geometry operation is invoked.

`validation/dev058/counter_relay.py --observer LOCAL_PORT --port METRICS_PORT --bind SERVER_LAN_IP --peer DESKTOP_LAN_IP`: private validation-only relay returns four fixed X11 input-delivery counters. It accepts only the designated desktop peer, reads only a fixed script over the existing localhost observer, receives no commands/data from the remote client, and closes each connection after one counter line. This avoids exposing the Tcl observer to the LAN. Used for immediate post-burst latency independent of SMB scheduling; no UI/controller/geometry mutations or product files. Console-only process log. Updated worker reloads the reviewed handler per request and records its SHA256 so receipts bind to exact test source; no historical release script is run.

Fresh journey03 revealed a product layout error in the feedback-label correction: its frame remained packed while selected toolbar children switched to grid, aborting Workbench initialization. Its screenshot is FAIL. The feedback frame is now initially unmanaged, constraints use the existing Finish anchor during construction, and only the completed toolbar grid layout manages feedback. Normal fresh-process revalidation is required; no release follows from source correction alone.

`validation/dev058/source_stamp.py FRAMEWORK EVIDENCE`: reads and hashes every candidate framework file and writes one immutable source-stamp.json in the new/private evidence directory. Refuses replacement. Captures source/adapter/documentation ownership for fresh GUI validation; no framework/release/Session writes. Final acceptance must match this inventory, with a fresh run after any source change; previously captured partial/failed runs are not retroactively upgraded.

Native pan extension: optional `drag ... COUNT FRAME_PREFIX SNAPSHOTS` samples actual client pixels during an unpaced continuous gesture (default3 frames; longer tests use12). Capture cadence, not a sleep between events, bounds the diagnostic gesture duration. Worker05 reloads the handler per request, so its SHA256 in each receipt identifies exact behavior. Renamed native matching storage away from PowerShell's automatic Matches variable. A120-motion/3-frame gesture moved the final view with93ms delivery backlog, but its motion frames still showed old geometry; this remains fluidity FAIL/pending, not a release PASS.

GUI timed-frame diagnostics: gui_host installs an execution timing trace on the already existing timed scientific frame callback when Workbench opens, recording enter/end/elapsed microseconds to private frame-trace.tsv. It observes actual user-event-driven execution and never calls the controller. The12-frame/604ms native drag remained visually stale until near release (161ms final delivery backlog), so fluidity still fails. Candidate _viewDrawNow now tries update idletasks after one complete timed frame to flush Tk painting without mouse/keyboard re-entry; this is a bounded host-only presentation hypothesis, not an accepted fix. Fresh native frames and timings must validate it.

Native input now restores only an iconic private window, and skips activation/thread pairing when the requested private window is already foreground. Repeated unconditional native Restore can perturb VcXsrv geometry/paint; it is not normal manual input. Exact-title/foreground/bounds guards remain. Existing failed/stale motion evidence stays failed; the same candidate is remeasured with minimally invasive input, and every new frame is inspected.

Wheel gesture setup now waits70ms after positioning the pointer, once before the unpaced burst. The earlier40-event counter increment accompanied an unchanged visible view, so it is not a zoom PASS: VcXsrv may still route immediate wheel input to the prior widget. Burst delivery counts must be accompanied by actual visible zoom, never treated as proof alone. Idle transport diagnosis also compares the simple glyph-only probe against the complete shared host; no app/viewer callback is invoked.

Dev058 publication gate FAILED. Actual native sustained-pan frames still show delayed position updates/catch-up. The bounded update-idletasks experiment was removed because it did not produce an acceptable fluid result; the dev05716ms coalescer/debounced persistence remains. No release/version bump/archive/deployment or authoritative release handoff update was performed. The operational unfinished TODO is restored byte-identically to workspace/candidate with the remaining dev058 acceptance work. See the unpublished failure report; do not run deployment scripts or begin another cycle.

### Integrated dev097 — shared Numeric native residual reductions

`validation/integrated_dev097/native_reductions.c` compiles against the public
`math.numeric/api/c/gxtxt_numeric_reductions_v1.h` binding and checks analytical
signed residuals, merge order, extreme finite magnitudes, zero/empty states,
nonfinite/count-overflow rejection and unchanged output on failure. Build into
a new private directory with C99 plus ASAN/UBSAN, then run that executable.
The existing `task9_dev052/native2d_compare.c` and `native2d_compare_geometry.c`
are reusable C fixtures for dev097's changed comparison reduction owner: compile
against candidate `core/native2d/gx2d.c` (C99, math library, sanitizers) and run
only those two fixtures. Source compatibility, million-row comparisons, sampling,
max-index, path/gaps and zoom invariance are checked; no full Native2D campaign.
Private build/log outputs and in-memory scenes only. Before staging a new native
adapter, build `cmake -S FRAMEWORK/core/native2d -B NEW_PRIVATE_BUILD

## Isolated full-release packaging (dev099–dev101)

`python3 -B validation/official_dev099/package_release.py FRAMEWORK EVIDENCE RELEASE_SPEC_JSON NEW_OUTPUT`
freezes an explicitly prepared isolated full framework. It never deploys, reads
or compares the user's working installation, changes VERSION/source product
versions or TODO contents, publishes to server sections, or writes restore points.
It rejects current/deposit/restore destinations and existing NEW_OUTPUT.

The JSON spec contains:

```json
{
  "version": "0.9.8.10-dev-099",
  "stem": "gxtxt_pipeline_v09810dev_099",
  "baseline_archive_sha256": "<64 lowercase hex digits from verified immutable predecessor>",
  "baseline_manifestfiles": "/absolute/path/to/baseline-files.json",
  "accepted_receipt_paths": [
    "plugins-gui-03/result.tcldict",
    {"path": "focused-receipt.json", "expected_status": "PASS"}
  ],
  "changed_module_versions": {"actual.changed.module": "1.2.3"},
  "status": "PASS_FROZEN_FULL_OFFICIAL_RELEASE",
  "limitations": [],
  "summary": "Exact approved release behavior",
  "authorized_removed_paths": [],
  "compact_evidence": ["plugins-gui-03/*.png", "plugins-completed-01.json"],
  "validation_directories": ["validation/official_dev099"],
  "change_rules": [
    {"paths": ["core/tcl/plugin_*"], "what": "Actual implemented behavior", "why": "Concrete problem resolved", "evidence": ["plugins-gui-03/result.tcldict"]}
  ]
}
```

`baseline_manifestfiles` also accepts the inventory dictionary itself. An optional
`baseline_archive` verifies the supplied immutable archive SHA; no mutable current
path is consulted. Receipt paths are relative to EVIDENCE; JSON and Tcl dictionary
receipts are parsed without evaluating Tcl. An entry can specify `status_key` and
an explicit string/list `expected_status`; the default is exactly PASS. Known
FAIL/BLOCKED receipts require an explicit non-PASS acceptance status, supporting
truthful NOT ACCEPTED / KNOWN BLOCKER delivery. `reused_evidence` records accepted
unchanged predecessor science/native evidence without rerunning it.

The parent prepares all source/product identities and TODO first. The helper
asserts VERSION.txt, the actual Tcl version, requested module versions and
module/package descriptor coherence. It discovers actual changed module payloads
from the complete predecessor inventory and refreshes only their existing
SHA256SUMS/SHA256SUMS.txt (or creates SHA256SUMS when absent). Unchanged supplied
plugins remain byte-identical even if their version is additionally asserted.
Every actual changed `core=0` module must already have a coherent
plugin-package.ini; it receives a deterministic flat source-matched Linux ZIP in
`plugin_packages/official_devNNN/` and NEW_OUTPUT/external_packages. CORE modules
remain framework-only. No binary file catalog is hard-coded: every compiled
payload is included and hashed like its actual source-tree file.

Optional `package_directory` selects another relative plugin_packages subfolder.
An existing different package ZIP/sidecar is preserved and refused; move its
preimage during authorized candidate preparation before retrying. Existing managed
registry entries must match the new version/package filename. Only an explicit
`allow_registry_updates: true` permits updating those two fields, with the exact
registry preimage retained in NEW_OUTPUT; missing registry entries are never
silently created. No plugin is installed or reclassified by packaging.

The helper copies the current workspace SCRIPT_CATALOG.md and only requested
workspace validation directories (default: official_dev099). `compact_evidence`
accepts explicit file/glob selections; private Session, configuration, generated
package and full test-tree copies are rejected. Accepted receipts are always
included. Optional `compact_destination` and `changed_file_report` choose
relative documentation destinations. WHAT/WHY/EVIDENCE rules use ordered glob
matches; exact before/after SHA receipts and removals are written externally.
`authorized_removed_paths` uses exact/glob paths or a trailing-slash prefix;
unlisted baseline removals are rejected.

The full candidate must contain no symlinks, special files or Python bytecode.
The helper refreshes the complete root framework manifest and established
catalog/TODO checksum sidecars. It generates a small genuine Tcl release probe,
loads the actual catalog, checks configured module versions and inspects each
new external ZIP through the real Plugin Install API. Optional `public_apis`
contains `{ "module": "actual.id", "api": "ACTUAL_API_v1" }` records for
necessary headless activation, `module_policies` asserts actual descriptor fields,
and `absent_module_ids` verifies expressly requested retirement identities.
`probe_timeout_seconds` defaults to120. No numerical or GUI matrix is run.

The deterministic full tar.gz, SHA sidecar and safely expanded tree must have
exact file parity; source and expanded public probes must leave scientific/source
bytes unchanged. NEW_OUTPUT/package.json contains version, archive, sha256,
expanded, manifest_sha256, files and external_packages `{id,version,archive,sha256}`
compatible with the existing non-activating deposit helper. The adjacent
framework-files.json, changed-files.json, removed-files.json, copied release spec,
source/expanded probe logs and compact evidence receipts make the result reviewable.
The helper does not deposit, activate, restart, update the active user directory,
run future tasks, or infer acceptance from packaging alone.

Set `require_change_rule_coverage: true` to reject uncovered substantive changed
files before archive creation. `change-rule-coverage.json` lists each path, its
ordered matching rule index, and whether it is generated bookkeeping. Compact
receipts, validation sources, generated package ZIPs/module checksums, the generated
ledger, VERSION.txt and established checksum/catalog sidecars have automatic
packaging coverage. Scientific/source/manual/TODO changes require an explicit
owner rule in strict mode. This prevents a large generic fallback ledger while
keeping generated artifact repetition out of the parent's rule list.

The actual managed registry is **plugins/.registry/installed.ini**. There is no
plugins/registry.ini authority. Module descriptors are
plugins/modules/MODULE_ID/module.ini and their independent package descriptors
are plugin-package.ini in the same folder. `allow_registry_updates` changes only
existing `[plugin.MODULE_ID]` version and package_file, retaining a preimage; the
parent remains owner of all other registry preparation and distribution policy.

`python3 -B validation/official_dev099/package_release.py --help` and in-memory
Python/Tcl syntax/literal checks have been run during helper authoring. The helper
has not been executed on a framework by its author; actual packaging/probe/parity
results must come from the coordinator's authorized invocation after source/GUI
acceptance. These static checks are not release acceptance.

## Additive official release handoff (dev099–dev101)

`python3 -B validation/official_dev099/finalize_release_handoff.py WORKSPACE RELEASE_SPEC_JSON HANDOFF_SPEC_JSON NEW_OUTPUT`
finalizes only an already deposited release. RELEASE_SPEC_JSON is the frozen
package.json or its versioned release spec. The helper does not execute development,
modify official framework source/archive contents, inspect/save/compare the active
installation, restart processes, change TODO contents, or launch the next task.

HANDOFF_SPEC_JSON supplies these explicit facts:

```json
{
  "date": "20261017",
  "evidence_root": "/absolute/private/release/evidence",
  "deposit_receipt": "deposit-01/deposit.json",
  "current_save_receipt": "current-save-01/current-save.json",
  "accepted": true,
  "acceptance_status": "OFFICIAL_RELEASE_VERIFIED_AND_CURRENT_FILES_SAVED",
  "summary": "Actual completed authorized release behavior",
  "isolated_install_receipts": ["isolated-install-01/completed.json"],
  "gui_receipts": [{"path": "gui-focused-01/result.tcldict", "expected_status": "PASS", "label": "Actual affected GUI workflow"}],
  "scientific_receipts": ["scientific-focused-01/result.tcldict"],
  "known_issues": [],
  "evidence_files": {"changed-files.json": "frozen-release-01/changed-files.json"},
  "evidence_globs": ["gui-focused-01/*.png"],
  "next_release": "dev100",
  "next_worktree": "/absolute/workspace/_work_gxtxt_dev100_official",
  "continuity_summary": "Exact coordinator status and remaining work."
}
```

Paths for receipts/evidence are relative to evidence_root unless absolute. JSON
and Tcl dictionary statuses are read without evaluating Tcl; default expected
status is exactly PASS and a record can set `expected_status`, `status_key` and
`label`. Recorded list/integer check counts are presented as supplied. Accepted
handoffs require actual successful deposit, matching required-current-save and
isolated-install/GUI receipts. A known failed/blocker status cannot be promoted;
use `accepted:false`, an explicit NOT ACCEPTED acceptance_status, precise
known_issues and exact expected failure statuses when the directive requires a
truthful blocker artifact handoff. No PASS is inferred from archive deposition.

The helper reads current backup/destination paths only from the actual
current-save receipt and never inspects those directories. The complete prior
working-directory backup remains owned by the controlled current-save workflow.
The official archive/version/SHA/expanded/manifest facts come from the deposit;
when RELEASE_SPEC_JSON contains sha256 it must match the deposit. No predecessor
science or native build matrix is rerun.

Optional `handoff_body_file` adds reviewed coordinator prose, `previous_release_deliveries`
accepts an explicit list of prior immutable delivery JSONs for the final101
consolidated four-release table, and `copy_capsule_to_restore_points:true` makes
an additive evidence-capsule restore copy. No task directory is scanned. The
next-release value must preserve099→100→101→stop; no dev102 action is allowed.

The generated capsule is
`GXTXT_DEVNNN_OFFICIAL_RELEASE_EVIDENCE_YYYYMMDD.zip` in the existing central
framework/archives section, with an exact framework/expanded same-stem directory.
It includes the generated handoff, exact specs and explicitly selected compact
receipts/screenshots/source files plus a complete SHA256SUMS. Private Sessions,
configuration/package trees, full test installations, symlinks and binary payloads
are refused. Its ZIP CRC, every expanded file SHA and new archive SHA are checked.
No prior artifact is overwritten. A matching server pair is created only for this
new capsule; historical release audits are not repeated. `server_root` defaults
to the established GXTXT repository; `compito` defaults to WORKSPACE/../compito.

WORKSPACE and compito receive exact new versioned handoff/delivery JSON files and
checksum sidecars. Their current handoff, revision, development pointer and both
current continuity files are preserved with their original checksum sidecars in
NEW_OUTPUT/preimages before atomic updates. Continuity gets a new top status
followed by all original historical bytes; previous versioned handoffs are never
rewritten. Existing versioned artifacts or NEW_OUTPUT cause refusal. Capsule
copies beside the handoffs are made by default; set
`copy_capsule_to_handoff_folders:false` to omit those redundant copies. Official
framework archives and expanded framework source remain unchanged.

NEW_OUTPUT retains the generated handoff, capsule source/ZIP/expanded pair,
delivery.json, exact pointer preimages, and handoff-receipt.json. The delivery
records actual acceptance, known issues, GUI/scientific/install receipts, original
archive SHA, official capsule SHA, current-save receipt and complete backup path.
The capsule hash is external in delivery JSON to avoid a self-referential archive.
Authoring validation is limited to Python syntax and CLI help; the helper is not
executed by its author. Only the coordinator invokes it after reviewed delivery.

# Native2D grid and Worksheet validation — dev100

Native builds use `cmake -S CANDIDATE/core/native2d -B NEW_BUILD -DBUILD_TESTING=OFF`, then `cmake --build NEW_BUILD -j2`. Build output and dependency headers remain in NEW_BUILD; installation into mutable or accepted releases is prohibited. The Native2D module and standalone geometry C ABI are checked separately. Debian development dependency extraction uses `apt-get download libcairo2-dev` in a new evidence build directory followed by `dpkg-deb -x`; this does not install or mutate system packages. Runtime Cairo is supplied by Debian's existing `libcairo.so.2`.

Focused GUI scripts and their exact arguments are added here before execution. They operate only on disposable test Sessions and the isolated dev100 candidate. DISPLAY :1 requires the parent-coordinated exclusive lease.

`grid_native_gui.tcl LIBRARY NEW_OUT` runs with `DISPLAY=:1 XAUTHORITY=/home/giu/.Xauthority wish …`. It opens the actual Native2D C++ grid, drives real X11 pointer/keyboard input through xdotool, checks independent viewport bounds/visible cell counts, records receipts/screenshots and source fixture SHA. New output directory only, no framework/Session/source mutation. `grid_baseline_gui.tcl OFFICIAL099 NEW_OUT` similarly opens the accepted Worksheet on a newly generated disposable Session and reproduces rapid-scroll/boundary behavior; it never edits the immutable baseline. Each script exits its own GUI.

`worksheet_grid_gui.tcl CANDIDATE NEW_OUT NATIVE_LIBRARY` runs actual candidate application/Worksheet on DISPLAY :1 with exclusive lease. Isolates XDG/Jobs/resources, creates a disposable source Dataset+Session, uses real X11 pointer/keyboard for direct editing, docked formulas, navigation/clipboard/History/Workspace and screenshots; records immutable scientific source SHA. First run is a focused integration harness, not the final frozen GUI campaign. No accepted/current/release mutations.
